title: Velvet Engine
style: synth-funk, slick groove, slap bass, talkbox, glittery synth leads, disco-house drums, confident male vocal, 110 bpm, midnight glamour
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Keys in the ignition, heart in overdrive
City in the rearview learning how to thrive
You said the night was empty, baby look around
Neon's painting halos on the underground

[Pre-Chorus]
Turn the dial up, turn the static down
This is how a heartbeat sounds in town

[Chorus]
Velvet engine running smooth
Every red light starts to move
We don't argue, we just glide
Gold reflections side by side
Velvet engine, velvet line
Everything is yours and mine
Just hold the wheel and let it sing
Velvet engine, velvet thing

[Verse 2]
Midnight calling collect, the bass line picks it up
Pour the moon a shot in a chrome diner cup
We don't need a map when the rhythm knows the route
Turn the basement into a citywide shout

[Pre-Chorus]
Turn the dial up, turn the static down
This is how a heartbeat sounds in town

[Chorus]
Velvet engine running smooth
Every red light starts to move
We don't argue, we just glide
Gold reflections side by side
Velvet engine, velvet line
Everything is yours and mine
Just hold the wheel and let it sing
Velvet engine, velvet thing

[Bridge - talkbox solo]
(funky talkbox phrasing)

[Outro]
Velvet, velvet, velvet engine
Driving on, driving on
